units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8:1">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>הוא חוֹזֵר עליה</he> he searches it again (tries to recover his scholarship); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8:1">ib.</cite> <he>יכול הוא לַחֲזוֹר עליה</he> he may recover it; a. e.; v. infra.

senses.gloss: to turn around, return; to retract, repent. Ib. חֲזוֹר בך come back (repent)! Eduy. V, 6 חזור בך withdraw thy opposition.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 4:1">Dem. IV, 1</cite> <he>חָזְרָה למקומה</he> came back to its place (was mixed up again).

<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 1:5">Maas. Sh. I, 5</cite> <he>יֶחְזְרוּ דמים וכ׳</he> the money shall return to its former condition, i.e. the sale is annulled, and the money has again its sacred character.
<cite ref="Keritot 8a:12">Ker. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>נַחֲזוֹר על הראשונות</he> let us go back to what was said first.

<cite ref="Shabbat 118b">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Arakhin 15b:102">Arakh. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>מימי</he> … <he>וחָזַרְתִּי לאחורי</he> I never said a word (about a fellowman) on which I went back (when confronted with him).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 59a:12">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>וחָזְרָה בה</he> and she reconsiders (her consent to be married); <he>חוֹזֶרֶת</he> she may do so; <cite ref="Gittin 32b">Gitt. 32ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 32b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>חוזר ומגרש בו</he> dare he use the same letter of divorce again (after he has revoked it)? <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 4:3">Ter. IV, 3</cite> <he>ח׳ והוסיף</he> then again he added.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:5">Gitt. IV, 5</cite> <he>חָזְרוּ לומר</he> then again they said (added); a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to go around from one to the other.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 53a:9">Yeb. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>צריכה לְחַזֵּר על וכ׳</he> she must apply to all the brothers successively; (ib. 26ᵇ; 51ᵇ <he>לַחֲזוֹר</he>). Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ bot. <he>חִיזַּרְנוּ על כל וכ׳</he> we searched the whole Bible; Y. Ab. Zar. I, beg. 39ᵃ <he>חי׳ בכל וכ׳</he>; (Sifré Deut. s. 1 <he>חָזַרְנוּ</he>). Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᶜ top, v. <cite ref="D00458"><he>דיאתימון</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 2b:13">Kidd. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>לחַזֵּר על אשה</he> to go around in search of a wife (to woo).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 2b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>מי חוֹזֵר על מי</he> (Kal) which of them goes around &c.?; <cite ref="Niddah 31b:46">Nidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מי מְחַזֵּר וכ׳</he>.
Ber. 27ᵇ המַחֲזִיר שלים לרבו he who returns the plain salutation (shalom) of his teacher (without adding, ‘My teacher’).
<cite ref="Berakhot 32b">Ib. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ה׳ לו שלום</he> did not answer his greeting.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 7b:8">B. Mets. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>יַחֲזִיר לאשה</he> he must restore (the lost document) to the wife.
<cite ref="Ketubot 73b:17">Keth. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>והֶחֱזִירָהּ</he> and re-married her; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to revoke; to reconsider, to grant a new trial.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 6:3">Gitt. VI, 3</cite> <he>אם רצה להַחֲזִיר לא יַחֲזִיר</he> if the husband wants to revoke the letter of divorce, he cannot do so.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1">Snh. IV, 1</cite> <he>דיני נפשות מַחֲזִירִין וכ׳</he> in capital cases verdicts may be reconsidered in favor of the defendant.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:1">Ib. VI, 1</cite> <he>מחזירין</he> the convict is brought back for a new trial; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Sanhedrin 33b:12">Ib. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>חוזר</he>, <he>אין מחזירין</he> Ms. F. (ed. <he>חוזרין</he>).]—
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 5:7">Eduy. V, 7</cite> <he>החזרת בך</he>, Mish. ed. <cite ref="H00572"><he>חָזַרְתָּ</he></cite>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: to make one read over, to cause correction. Y. Meg. IV, 74ᵈ מחזירין אותו we order him to read it over again correctly.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 29a">Ber. 29ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
